trusted_advisor_positioning_20261120.statement_nl: Ik help ondernemers en teams complexe bedrijfsfricties terugbrengen tot eenvoudige, robuuste en toekomstbestendige manieren van werken: technologie, software, AI, BI en data als één intelligent, veilig en menselijk beheersbaar systeem.
trusted_advisor_positioning_20261120.distinctive_promise: First simplify the work; then connect its data, applications, intelligence and decisions. Deliver observable outcomes and clear ownership instead of another tool dependency.
principles: Trusted advisor: onafhankelijke analyse, ook adviseren NIET te automatiseren wanneer risico of businesscase dat vraagt
Company Graph -> Context -> Intelligence -> Agents -> Actions -> Outcomes -> Learning: ONE integrated software/AI/BI/data operating model

Agentic AI is bounded execution with task-specific least-privilege tools, approvals, exception handling, human override, monitoring, audit evidence, idempotent retries and rollback; never a promise of autonomy without controls
Simple portal UX: Wat speelt er? Wat gebeurt er? Wat werkt aantoonbaar?; begrijpelijke taal and clear next action for busy owner
Person-independent and technology-portable: named plus backup process owners, documented decisions, open contracts/APIs, export, adapter isolation, model routing and substitution
Robust now and scalable later: reliability SLO, tests, fallback, observability, durable handovers, costs and service ownership

Responsible AI by design: AI/system register, intended purpose and AI Act role/risk assessment, GDPR/DPIA as relevant, transfer map, retention, access, vendor/subprocessor inventory, incident and evidence trails
Data sovereignty is demonstrated control over location, legal access, processing, portability and exits; EU hosting by itself is NOT sovereign or GDPR compliant
Train humans from AI fundamentals to advanced agentic implementation and adoption, with working examples, safe data and measurable skill transfer
Innovations are shipped, verified in real destinations and independently assessed; a demo, PR or plan is not a client outcome

editorial_rules.rotation: One relevant personally evidenced decision, dilemma, surprise, challenge or learning per post; rotate angles and format, no catalog dump or repetitive trusted-advisor tagline
editorial_rules.voice: Arthur first-person practitioner and strategic adviser with grounded humility; explain why one tradeoff matters to a real entrepreneur; make technical sophistication understandable without condescension
editorial_rules.guard: Do not convert public MKB friction or imagined workshop/training experience into personal firsthand claims; no fake customer names, role details, metrics, client outcomes, qualifications or certifications
editorial_rules.content_vs_offer: Personal profile: observations, decisions, dilemmas and lessons; company page, site and portal: specific offerings, capability limits and valid CTA; never simply duplicate copy
editorial_rules.meaningful_discussion: Offer a genuine alternative/constraint/counterexample worth discussing; no generic closing question, bait, forced controversy or hard sell
editorial_rules.claim_status: Differentiate personally verified prior experience, currently verifiable Powerhouse feature, architectural target, proposed future service and user-confirmed intent
